attchmntText: Weizmann Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Weizmann Limited submitted newspaper advertisements for its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The publication appeared in Financial Express and Mumbai Lakshadeep on 13th November, 2026. DhanSafal Finserve Limited approved its un-audited financial results for the same period during a Board meeting held on 12th November, 2026. Comfort Commotrade Limited also approved its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026, following a Board meeting on 12th November, 2026. Crown Lifters Limited released its statement of financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.

attchmntText: Weizmann Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Weizmann Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 12th November 2026. The Board approved the Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The approval covers both Standalone and Consolidated results, accompanied by Limited Review Reports from Statutory Auditors Batliboi & Purohit. The Standalone Profit Before Tax for the half year was Rs. 332.18 lakhs, compared to Rs. 497.33 lakhs in the previous period. The Standalone Profit for the period stood at Rs. 234.49 lakhs. Total Assets as of 30th September 2026 were Rs. 10,456.37 lakhs. The meeting commenced at 4.15 p.m. and concluded at 4.50 p.m. The company operates in the textile processing and manufacturing sector.
